name: Radiant Star Beauty

address.streetAddress: 4390 N Federal Hwy Suite 207, Fort Lauderdale, 33308

reviews.author: GEORGETTE M…
reviews.body: Love my lashes everytime! She always responds fast, she helps you choose the look you are trying to achieve, while you are there she educates you on your lashes and skin type and what products she recommends for at home skin care. My first time getting a facial and it was everything, she also has a massage chair and gives you a blanket, best time to get a nap in! Prices are very reasonable and worth it for the quality of care she provides

reviews.author: Mariah S…
reviews.body: I had such an anazing experience! The facial had my skin glowing and the lash set came out perfect and super natural but still gave me that extra glam. The vibe was relaxing and the service was so welcoming. Okami is my favorite esthetician. Definitely will be a returning client! 💗

owner_full_name_sunbiz: Okami Brown (registered agent/manager, Sunbiz filing L25000417773)
has_own_site_check: Confirmed via booksy_dossier.py website_candidates (empty), plus web searches for radiantstarbeauty.com and "Radiant Star Beauty" website (2026-07-23): only Booksy, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Sunbiz corporate filing found. No independent domain.
email_note: Not publicly listed. Sources checked: Booksy dossier JSON-LD/page (no mailto), raw Booksy page curl (no tel:/mailto), Instagram profile page fetch (login-walled, no bio/external_url exposed; web_profile_info endpoint is known broken per pipeline notes), TikTok @radiantstarbeauty profile page (bio/desc field has no email or link), Facebook page fetch (login-walled, About section not accessible), Sunbiz corporate filing (403 on direct fetch). No linktree/poplme link found in any of the above.
phone_note: Not publicly listed. Sources checked: booksy_dossier.py (telephone field null), raw Booksy page HTML (no tel: link, no telephone/phone JSON keys; matched digit sequences were false positives - fb:app_id and an image hash), web search for "Radiant Star Beauty" Fort Lauderdale phone number (no result), Sunbiz filing fetch blocked (403).
brand_vibe: Warm gold/champagne quiet luxury: gold script wordmark and outline star logo, cream/blush marketing flyer ("self care is your super power", "Where the star glows the brightest"), black-background before/after graphics with gold OKAMI LUXE watermark. Base: light-v2 (cream bg, warm dark-brown ink, gold accent).
template_base: templates/light-v2 (anchor: Lash Bloom, West Palm Beach)
image_sourcing_notes: booksy_dossier.py + booksy_gallery.py downloaded 16 photos (bk-1..bk-16). Visual curation (contact sheet review): most were marketing graphics with baked-in text/captions (before/after collages with BEFORE/AFTER labels, lash-type infographics with thickness/density text, a quote card, tiny 100x100 thumbnails) which are prohibited for gallery tiles per pipeline rule against text overlays. Rescued usable real photography by cropping clean, text-free regions out of the flyer photo (bk-1, an actual studio/treatment photo bundled inside the marketing graphic) and out of 4 before/after macro shots (isolating just the finished lash close-up, cropping out the BEFORE/AFTER captions and OKAMI LUXE logo corner). Also kept one unedited client selfie (bk-7, no text, eyes open, smiling) and the gold star logo graphic (bk-2) for the site logo. Attempted IG rescue via scripts/ig_photos.py radiantstarbeauty (Playwright, local fallback): returned only 1 generic Instagram marketing placeholder image (not real profile content), discarded and unused. Final images used are derived crops, not stock: assets/raw/hero-face.jpg, hero-hands.jpg, result-braids.jpg, lash-classic.jpg, lash-hybrid.jpg, lash-volume.jpg, lash-mega.jpg, lash-glam.jpg, client-smile.jpg, logo.jpg.
